Container.Name: bifrost-ai-gateway
Container.Overview: Bifrost AI Gateway by Maxim provides an OpenAI-compatible API for multiple AI providers, with model routing, fallbacks, virtual keys and a web dashboard. This community template runs the unmodified official maximhq/bifrost image. Configure the gateway through its web interface after installation.

Config.Name: Web UI and API
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Bifrost web dashboard and API. Change the host port if it is already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent gateway data. Configure the application after installation using its web dashboard.
